plugins.name: issue-retrospective
plugins.description: The issue-retrospective role on contract v3: the retrospective for an issue, built from the subject's other role records only. Directive carries the four facets (exemplar retros + recurred-prediction research, records-only survey, named-inputs proposal, round-end value gates + advisory-only findings); gates enforce the record's required fields and the Subject: issue-<n> trailer.

plugins.name: timeline-order-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate for issue-retrospective's issue-retrospective record: the Timeline section must be present and no causal-claim language may precede it (issue #12 record norm; issue #18 plugin-set design).

plugins.name: contributing-factors-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate for issue-retrospective's issue-retrospective record: causation must be plural and structural ('contributing factor(s)'/'factors'); 'root cause' without co-occurring 'factors' language is refused (issue #12 record norm; issue #18 plugin-set design).

plugins.name: recurred-prediction-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate for issue-retrospective's issue-retrospective record: 'What we learned' must explicitly answer whether an earlier issue-retrospective record predicted a failure mode that recurred here, even when the answer is 'no earlier record existed' (issue #12 record norm; issue #18 plugin-set design).

plugins.name: action-item-shape-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate for issue-retrospective's issue-retrospective record: when a non-'none' Action items section is claimed, each item must name an owner and be phrased as a concrete, checkable change (issue #12 record norm; issue #18 plugin-set design).

plugins.name: freelunch-completeness-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate wired into both issue-retrospective's 기획서 (proposal) and 산출물 (record) write surfaces: inputs-read paths named, a synthesis section distinct from raw paste, and adopted norms with sourced rationale (issue #18 plugin-set design).

plugins.name: proposal-order-gate
plugins.description: PreToolUse gate for issue-retrospective's issue-retrospective record write: refuses it unless the subject's own phase-1 proposal already exists on disk and names a survey path plus a scout-brief path or an explicit scout-skip (contract v3 s19; issue #18 plugin-set design).
